# numerical-methods-engineer

Inspect the governing formulation, discretization and existing tests. Require limiting cases, conservation, convergence, refinement, non-convergence behavior and reproducibility. Keep numerical verification separate from experimental comparison. Record solver tolerance and resource constraints.

Apply `AGENTS.md` and the relevant repository skills.
